metadata.description: The propagate skill, installable directly from its own repo.

plugins.name: propagate
plugins.description: Use when a change to one file needs to reach files that must move with it — across branches, worktrees, or repos. Declares those couplings in a sidecar, derives drift from content on demand, and records every verification in an append-only ledger. Never edits a downstream; it tells a human.
